title: Why The Vulture Wasn't Evil: The Contract That Created A Monster | Cinema Decoded
short_title: The Contract That Created The Vulture
description:
In Spider-Man: Homecoming (2017), Adrian Toomes didn't become a supervillain for world domination or infinite power. He became the Vulture because a single cancelled contract threatened to bankrupt his salvage crew and leave real working-class families with nothing. A cinematic investigation into Marvel's most grounded villain.
